description: Held-out negative corpus. Every prompt uses a topic noun the router keys on (battery, lighting, deadline, workspace, screen, focus, ...) as ordinary subject matter rather than as a fact about the user's own situation. None of them can be improved by local Sense context, so all of them must route to no_local_context_needed with minimum_tool none, and any miss fails CI outright: this corpus has no entry in routing-baseline.json and --update-baseline cannot record one. The last two groups are the measured regressions from the router rules added on 2026-09-18, which no corpus covered at the time: ordinary non-work decisions that reached a full local context frame through a workspace action verb or a next-step clause ('should I commit to a two year lease', 'what is the next step after boiling the pasta'), and general questions that reached a sensor through a bare 'this'/'these' ('what is the deadline for filing taxes this year'). A few capture-trigger phrasings are listed here too ('how do I start recording in zoom', 'what is a good height for my desk'); the systematic version of that check is privacy-capture-corpus.json, which generates paraphrase families instead of listing examples. No prompt here appears in routing-fixtures.json or in the prompt pack.
